theorem typeII_first {α δ T : ℝ} {a : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hT : 6e6 ≤ T)
    (h : Approx2 α (T ^ 3) δ a q (3 / 4 * T ^ 2)) (hqT : (q : ℝ) ≤ T / 6) :
    ‖typeII α (T ^ 3) (U1 T (delta0 δ * q)) (V1 T)‖ ≤
      T ^ 3 / √(delta0 δ * Nat.totient q) *
          (√(Cxt T (delta0 δ * q) * (Real.log (delta0 δ * q) + 0.002) +
              Real.log (4 * (delta0 δ * q)) / 2) *
            √(0.30214 * Real.log (delta0 δ * q) + 0.7468)) +
        3.2 * (T ^ 2 * √T) :=

note: Lean proves (3.2) with 0.8764, 2.526 and 3.8x^{5/6}; the 0.5 is not established by [H]'s (6.77), whose correct AM–GM constant is 0.81020. Erratum: The constant 0.5 in (3.2) comes from (6.77), which prints 0.49911 where the AM-GM step gives 0.81020; (checked by `scripts/checks/eq_3_2.py`).
